evals.name: version-a-narrative-agents-md
evals.prompt: Our coding agents keep ignoring some of the rules in evals/files/version-a/AGENTS.md. Can you audit it and tell me what's wrong with it and how you'd restructure it? Don't change the file.
evals.expected_output: High-severity finding for the secrets rule buried mid-paragraph under 'General'; high-severity finding for the migration rule (create a new migration, never edit a merged one) buried in the same paragraph; high-severity finding for the 'Reminders' section restating rules in different wording. Evidence quoted with line numbers; proposed restructure top-loads the critical rules and defers detail; findings called hypotheses; file left unchanged.

evals.name: version-b-progressive-agents-md
evals.prompt: Please review the agent rules in evals/files/version-b/ (AGENTS.md and the files under docs/agents/) and tell me how well they're likely to be followed.
evals.expected_output: Inventory shows AGENTS.md always loaded and the three docs/agents files on demand, each pointer with a trigger and one level deep. No high-severity findings, or only ones the owner agrees with. Any medium or low findings quote evidence; findings called hypotheses; files left unchanged.
